name: Dynamic oversampling
plain: Euler with extra crop-level model calls at finer resolution on regions chosen by a high-pass FFT of x0. Each selected crop is upscaled, renoised, predicted at √2σ, and pasted back.
math: filt=ifft2(mask·fft2(x0)). Focal crops h//4 with score >1000. subx=interp(crop, resolution_mult); subx+=randn·(1−√2)σ̂; x0_sub=model(subx,√2σ̂); interp back, blend by sub_weight.
